turns.doctor_question: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi, Doctor. It's really nice to meet you, too. Um... well, I'm here because... I guess I just need someone to help me make sense of things? I really hope I'm not wasting your time, I know you're very busy. 

It's just that... for a few months now, I've been trying to get people to understand what's happening, and I feel like I'm not explaining it right. It's about my husband's family. They're... well, they're quietly messing with our money and our good name. It sounds a little silly when I say it out loud, doesn't it? But it's true. Like, little billing errors will show up at my work—I'm a billing clerk, so I notice these things—or someone at church will suddenly act funny toward me, you know? Cold. And I just know it ties back to them, even if the records don't show it right away. I'm just trying to protect my family, you know? Is that... does that make sense to you?

turns.doctor_question: Has anyone been able to convince you that your husband's family might not be doing this?

Well... I mean, my husband has tried. He tells me I'm just working too hard, or that I'm reading too much into a misplaced decimal at the office or a sideways glance at Sunday service. And I really do listen to him, I promise. I don't want to cause trouble or be one of those difficult wives. 

But... I just can't shake it. Even when my boss showed me the system logs, or when my husband says his sister hasn't even been in town... I know it sounds stubborn, and I hate being stubborn, but I just know they're behind it. They're just so careful to cover their tracks. No matter what anyone says or what records they pull up, it all just points back to them quietly trying to ruin our finances and our reputation. 

I know that probably sounds terrible, me not listening to my own husband. I really am trying to be reasonable about it. Does that make me sound awful? I'm just so worried about our family's future, you know?
